# PRASA IP

> PRASA IP is an intellectual property law firm in JP Nagar, Bengaluru (Bangalore), India, with a US office (PRASA IP LLC). Patent and trade mark attorneys for technology companies, founded in 2023 by Praneetha K Rasbag and Sanath V Madgula, registered Indian patent agents and advocates.

Contact: +91 91132 14395 · contact@prasaip.com · 481, 5th Cross Rd, Kothanur Main Rd, RBI Layout, JP Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560078, India

## Services
- [Patent services](https://www.prasaip.com/patent-services/): patent drafting, filing and prosecution in India, the US and through the PCT; patent searches; SEP claim charts
- [Software and AI patents in India](https://www.prasaip.com/software-ai-patents-india/): Section 3(k), the 2025 CRI Guidelines, drafting and examination responses
- [Trade mark services](https://www.prasaip.com/trademark-services/): search, registration, opposition and enforcement
- [Industrial design registration in India](https://www.prasaip.com/industrial-design-registration-in-india/): Designs Act 2000, filing steps, 10 + 5 year term
- [Additional IP services](https://www.prasaip.com/additional-ip-services/): copyright, geographical indications, layout designs
- [International patent support](https://www.prasaip.com/international-patent-support/): foreign filing coordination
